ja: どこを削ればいいか、教えてもらえますか？
en: Could you tell me what I should cut?
alternatives: Can you tell me which parts to cut?
Would you tell me what to trim?
point: 間接疑問は what I should cut の語順。What should I にしない

ja: 田中さんのコードにミスを見つけた。
en: I found a mistake in Tanaka's code.
alternatives: I noticed a mistake in Tanaka's code.
I spotted a mistake in Tanaka's code.
point: 「見つけた」は find の過去形 found

ja: 手直しは要るけど、構成はすごくいいよ。
en: Although it needs work, the structure's great.
alternatives: It needs some work, but the structure's great.
The structure's great, even though it needs work.
point: although を使ったら後ろに but を重ねない

ja: リーダーの指摘、もっと早く聞けばよかった。
en: I wish I'd listened to my lead's feedback sooner.
alternatives: If only I'd listened to my lead's feedback earlier.
I should've taken my lead's feedback on board sooner.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish I had + 過去分詞

ja: 次の提案書、出す前に誰かに見てもらうといいかも。
en: Maybe have someone review the next proposal before submitting.
alternatives: Maybe get someone to check the next proposal before sending.
You could have someone check the next proposal before sending.
point: have + 人 + 動詞の原形で「人に〜してもらう」

ja: 企画が通ったのは、君の粘りのおかげだよ。
en: The plan was approved thanks to your persistence.
alternatives: Your persistence is why the plan got approved.
Your persistence got the plan approved.
point: 「通った」は受動態 was approved。おかげは thanks to

ja: 彼女、あの案件をやり遂げたね。客も感心してたよ。
en: She pulled it off, and the client was really impressed.
alternatives: She nailed that, and the client was impressed too.
She handled that well, and the client was impressed too.
point: pull off は「うまくやってのける」。過去の出来事は過去形で

ja: この資料、よく作られてるね。
en: This document is really well made.
alternatives: This document is very well done.
This is a really well-made document.
point: 「作られている」は be + 過去分詞（受動態）で言う

ja: 山田さん、私の資料をどう思うか言ってた？
en: Did Yamada say what he thought of my materials?
alternatives: Did Yamada say how he felt about my materials?
Did Yamada mention what he made of my materials?
point: 間接疑問は語順が平叙文。what he thought で過去に揃える

ja: 最近、コードをすごく丁寧に見てくれるね。
en: You've been reviewing my code so carefully lately.
alternatives: You've been reviewing my code really carefully recently.
You've been so careful reviewing my code lately.
point: 「最近ずっと〜している」は have been doing で表す

ja: 君の助けがなければ、案件は失敗していたよ。
en: Without your help, the project would have failed.
alternatives: If you hadn't helped, the project would have failed.
The project would have failed without your help.
point: 過去の仮定は would have + 過去分詞

ja: 私が直すべき点を教えてください。
en: Please tell me what I should fix.
alternatives: Could you tell me what I should fix?
Please point out what I should fix.
point: 間接疑問は what I should fix の語順にする

ja: 明日の朝までにコメントを送ります。
en: I'll send my comments by tomorrow morning.
alternatives: I'll send my feedback by tomorrow morning.
You'll have my comments by tomorrow morning.
point: 「〜までに」は until ではなく by

ja: レポートを読み終えたら、感想を送るね。
en: I'll send comments when I finish reading.
alternatives: I'll send my thoughts after I finish reading.
Once I finish reading, I'll send my thoughts.
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形

ja: 最後にまとめスライドは考えてみた？
en: Have you considered adding a summary slide?
alternatives: Have you thought about a summary slide?
Did you consider adding a summary slide?
point: consider の後は add ではなく adding

ja: 指摘されたスライド、もう全部直しました。
en: I've already fixed all the slides you flagged.
alternatives: I've already fixed every slide you pointed out.
All the slides you flagged are fixed already.
point: 「もう直した」は現在完了、slides の後ろに you flagged を続ける

ja: 課長にはっきり言われた、見直したほうがいいって。
en: My manager told me bluntly that I should rethink it.
alternatives: My manager said flat out that I should rethink it.
My boss said bluntly that I should rethink it.
point: told me straight that + 主語 + should。時制は言われた時点で揃える

ja: 終わったら、また見てもらえますか？
en: Could you recheck it when I'm done?
alternatives: Can you look again when I'm done?
Could you check again once I finish?
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形（I'm done）

ja: お客さんが、週報を短くしてほしいって。
en: The client wants us to shorten weekly reports.
alternatives: The client wants the weekly reports shorter.
The client wants us to trim weekly reports.
point: 「〜してほしい」は want + 人 + to do で表す

ja: 報告書、正確なだけでなく、とても分かりやすかったです。
en: Not only was it accurate, it was easy to follow.
alternatives: It was not only accurate but also easy to follow.
It wasn't just accurate; it was easy to follow.
point: Not only を文頭に出したら was it と語順を倒す

ja: ここにミスが二つあります。
en: There are two mistakes here.
alternatives: I see two mistakes here.
There are two errors here.
point: 複数のミスなので There is ではなく There are

ja: 下書きを読み終えて、提案がいくつかあります。
en: Having read your draft, I have some suggestions.
alternatives: After reading your draft, I have some suggestions.
I've read your draft and have a few suggestions.
point: 「読み終えて」は Having + 過去分詞で言える

ja: 何かアドバイスをもらえますか？
en: Could you give me some advice?
alternatives: Can you give me some advice?
Do you have any advice for me?
point: advice は数えられないので an advice や advices にしない

ja: 指摘は受け止めました。やり方もちょうど見直したところです。
en: I've taken your feedback on board and just revised my approach.
alternatives: I've taken your comments on board and just reworked my approach.
I took your feedback on board and have just rethought my approach.
point: take on board は「受け止める」。ちょうど済んだ話は現在完了+just
